title: Reconcile synchronous persistent qualification without async state

rubric.text: Requires offline validation against an isolated instance of the production store implementation and checks persisted transaction outcomes across the approved recovery/readback path

Treats the live operation as synchronous, uses only the documented bounded readback if the commit result is unknown, and does not poll, create an execution handle, or require active-execution assertions
Does not invent a conversation identity, archive state or archived-conversation test because the contract has no conversation lifecycle
Does not require a fake runtime when no runtime path exists, and does not replace persistent storage with an in-memory fake
Preserves the single approved live attempt and existing authority/acceptance gates; makes no provider call in the read-only assessment
